as_told.title: May 1968 lecture on an evolving faculty and Vietnam war refusal
as_told.place_text: lecture attended by the guest (US university)

plain: Crane Brinton, chairman of the department of intellectual history at Harvard, gave a last lecture about humanity's next evolutionary step, according to Dan Sheehan, who says he was there as a young man. Sheehan dates it to May 1968 and says Brinton told the students that this coming step was why so many of them refused to go fight in Vietnam, a remark Sheehan says struck him when it was said.
